about_the_game:
This dlc includes 16 characters' emoji. This is a present for players who support me and play through the game. Thank you.

Where is the emoji

Please click to "library" and right click When The Rumors Become Real icon. Then choose "manage" and choose "browse the folder". Then the "When the rumors become real_emoji" folder should be found.
